name: hoh1-standins
about: The four features with Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 content, packed as released (no --with-local, so no HoH1 content: the Forsaken Tower, the HoH1 classes' art, the HoH1 pets, the HoH1 trinkets' icons): each loads on its stand-in, hwplib tells the player once which ones (HWP::HoH1, the setting hoh1.told), hwp hoh1 lists them, and the log is clean.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:campaign\] self-check done: mission ok, .*HoH1 floors not imported
steps.name: the campaign loads on HoH2 themes
the trinkets keep their placeholder icons

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 content is not installed, so these use stand-ins: the Forsaken Tower runs on HoH2 themes, not the HoH1 levels; the HoH1 classes and the Remastered specs show placeholder icons; the HoH1 pets are not in the Pet Shop; the HoH1 trinkets show placeholder icons\.
steps.name: the chat line names them

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] pets: the HoH1 pets are not in the Pet Shop
steps.name: hwp hoh1 lists them

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 content is not installed
steps.name: told once

allow: Resource name hash conflict in package 'mods/(HWP-[a-z0-9]+|HammerwatchPlus-All)\.bin' for file
